Flips, rotates, scales and translates a raster.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Transform, Rotate, Flip, Scale, Translate, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterTransformer`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to transform. |
| `pInterpolation` | String |  | `nearest neightbour` | The interpolation of the values of the rotated raster. Allowed values: `nearest neightbour`, `bilinear`. |
| `pTransX` | Double | m |  | The translation along the X axis. |
| `pTransY` | Double | m |  | The translation along the Y axis. |
| `pScaleX` | Double |  |  | The scale factor along the X axis. |
| `pScaleY` | Double |  |  | The scale factor along the Y axis. |
| `doFlipHorizontal` | boolean |  | `false` | Flip horizontally, mirroring the columns. |
| `doFlipVertical` | boolean |  | `false` | Flip vertically, mirroring the rows. |
| `pNorth` | Double |  |  | The northing of the pivot of rotation and scale (default the center of the raster). |
| `pEast` | Double |  |  | The easting of the pivot of rotation and scale (default the center of the raster). |
| `pAngle` | Double | degrees |  | The counterclockwise rotation angle. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The transformed raster. |
| `outBounds` | output file |  | The outline of the transformed raster. |
